translation_notes: @graph target declared once at the top of the function; target is never reassigned so a single declaration covers every branch
each g.add((uri, RDF.type, OWL.X)) becomes {uri} a owl:X (rdf:type abbreviated as 'a', still the same prefixed-name construction)

rdflib.Literal(source.lbl) is a plain (untyped, unlagged) literal built from a str; the language's default coercion of a str value is a plain literal, so a bare interpolation {source.lbl} preserves it -- no need to keep the rdflib.Literal(...) call

context_shim.py replaces the oaklib.datamodels.obograph import (package not installed) and stands in for OboGraphToRdfOwlConverter's self, providing _uri_ref and a stub _convert_meta; _convert_meta itself is outside the region and is not exercised (meta=None in every fixture)

self is passed through the harness's call/arg comparison, which is not graph-aware for arbitrary objects; context_shim.Converter defines __eq__/__hash__ as class-only equality (it is stateless) purely so the fixture objects compare equal across the two runs -- not a change to the region's semantics
